## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The mixed-case write defect should be fixed because the new setter violates the cache’s case-insensitive lookup behavior. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — After `c.set("ALPHA", 1)`, both `c.get("ALPHA")` and `c.get("alpha")` return `None`: the setter stores the original key, while `get` lowercases every lookup. The round-trip test only writes a lowercase key, so it misses this failure. — Callers cannot retrieve mixed-case writes, and differently cased writes fail to update the same logical entry. — Fix: Store under `key.lower()` and test mixed-case writes and replacement.
